question: If n leaves a remainder of 3 when divided by 4, what is the unit digit of 2 + 2² + 2³ + ... + 2^n?
solution: The sum is 2^(n + 1) − 2. When n leaves 3, n + 1 is a multiple of 4, so 2^(n + 1) ends in 6 and the sum ends in 6 − 2 = 4.
questionHi: यदि n को 4 से भाग देने पर शेष 3 बचता है, तो 2 + 2² + 2³ + ... + 2^n का इकाई अंक क्या है?
solutionHi: योग 2^(n + 1) − 2 है। n का शेष 3 होने पर n + 1, 4 का गुणज है, अतः 2^(n + 1) का इकाई अंक 6 और योग का 6 − 2 = 4।

question: How many zeros are there at the end of 500! ÷ 250!?
solution: 500! has 100 + 20 + 4 = 124 fives and 250! has 50 + 10 + 2 = 62. The quotient keeps 62 fives and many more 2s (494 − 244 = 250), so 62 zeros.

question: How many zeros are there at the end of 100! ÷ (50! × 50!)?
solution: 100! has 24 fives and 50! × 50! has 12 + 12 = 24 fives, so no 5 is left in the quotient. With no factor 5 it cannot end in 0: 0 zeros.
solutionHi: 100! में 24 पाँच और 50! × 50! में 12 + 12 = 24, अतः भागफल में कोई 5 नहीं बचता। बिना 5 के यह 0 पर समाप्त नहीं हो सकता: 0 शून्य।

question: How many zeros are there at the end of 50! × 51! × 52!?
solution: Each of 50!, 51! and 52! has 10 + 2 = 12 fives (no new multiple of 5 after 50). Total 36 fives, with plenty of 2s: 36 zeros.
